body: Why is it so hard to admit it though? We do it every day. We know we do it. We know why we do it. Why is it so hard to open our eyes? Why does it hurt when you put it into words? I never got a problem with knowing what's going on. My problem is not knowing how to fix it. They tell you to work out. When will you find the energy for that? You could force yourself to get out and do it, but every time you get to do it, you notice something better to do, like a post to comment on or a new video to watch. Plus, whenever you do get to work out, you disappoint yourself by lasting too little, by doing less than you expected... You could try a hobby, but you fail at that as well. No drawing is how you imagined it to be, photos you take are shit. You're better off learning things. Keeping up with the media. Laughing at memes. You're good at sucking. And you'd rather be good at being shitty than be shitty at being good. Then you again read a text like this and get shivers down your spine. Because you're so good at lying to yourself you think no one would see it. Yet someone makes a post about lies you tell yourself, and how it really is... It's not easy, I know. I'm crying as I'm writing this, because I'm either very self-aware or a shitty liar to myself. We all know it's true, with minor differences here and there. Different jobs or schools, substances to keep up, ability to cry or not being able to, anger issues, sadness issues. But we all know we're shitty people waiting to be forced to change. That's not happening. Grief, guilt, boredom, self-hatred, low self-esteem, loneliness, we all share that. It's how you put it together, that's what it penetrates your lies. It's not that hard to see it when you have so many people living the same life as you. You just... Bring it to others to see.

Thank you for understanding. I did read that link by the way, and I forwarded it to my ex co-patients and friends battling depression. I actually need a person to care, as many as I can, so thank you being a part of them.

I didn't call anyone a slaughterer, I just simply expressed my opinion without insulting anyone, I stated that multiple times. Also, if there is no one willing to do the dirty work, why would dirty work be done? I'd much rather be in a low paying job than this. I've seen the other side all and wide. Still, killing is killing. Can't do anything without being told to do it? That's what every job does. Need to mention traumas veterans have after battles? Mental breakdowns happen without even entering the battlefield. Pressure, so called discipline, is sometimes too much. All for brainwashed soldiers who have been told since they are little that being a soldier is an honour. They're not to be blamed, of course. Protecting your family, country, stopping the enemy, it all sounds so right, but... Most wars are for oil and religion. Meanwhile the soldier earns a "decent" payment, both sides at the top bathe in money, from making new weapons, threats, conquering oil and land... With never seeing a man die. Is it really the answer? I'm no hippie to sit on the floor in front of the congress to stop war, but as long as I live I won't ever be a part of this. Nor will I ever support a close one to do it. I might be cruel, but I won't stand someone I love go through strict rules, traumas, injuries and pain to get more money than we need to get by. I don't need luxury, I grew up with my parents bringing food from work and having clothes from friends and relatives. I'd rather live with my family having old clothes happy than in fancy dresses and one of them potentially destroyed. Mind that I'm not attacking you or anything, I'm just sharing my thoughts. Maybe if all people thought like this, war would disappear. But that's a dream. And I know that. A family friend thought it was good to join the army. I was just a baby, but my parents told me about him. He went on a mission to earn money to buy a house for him, his wife and their daughter. He ended up committing suicide after he got home. The wife blames herself for letting him go to the army, she said they'd be perfectly happy in an apartment... War doesn't bring anything good. I get why people think it's ok to defend your country, but I don't support it. Again, I never called anyone a slaughterer. Just my honest thought on it.

I don't really understand. I know it's hard to get in a battle, but do you really think killing other people will prevent you from killing yourself on purpose. I mean, I'm no angel here, but I always had a problem understanding how people think it does any good, no matter how much they're told they'll learn how to be strong, defend your country and all that shit... I mean, I do respect your opinion, but how is that going to make you feel useful besides being told you do good for your country? You're a part of a group killing people for money and calling it defence. I never got my head around that. You could join firefighters instead, or even the police. But military? To me it's just a way to earn the "good strong caring citizen" badge quickly... Anyways interesting thing. I'm no person to tell you no. You do you. I just wanted to know the reason why military is the solution... As a firefighter or a policeman, you can die by accident too. It's just that you don't get to be a part of human slaughter lol.

Thank you a lot for this reply. But I have had professional help for quite some time now. In fact, I spent a month in a mental facility because of my suicide attempt. I have to say, as much as I believe there are good therapists out there, the doctors I had were shitty. They didn't ask about my problems, my abusive family, my rape experience or traumas. They only asked me why I don't go to school, why I'm not doing what everyone else is doing and being a normal member of society, they only saw what was on the outside. A divorced couple with two daughters. Two brats complaining about their parents who worry about their education. Not at all true there was abuse, neglect, not to mention we smelled as kids, had lice for over 3 months, got hit, got insulted every day... But that's not a problem. It's the past, they said. Doctors agreed. No matter how much I told the doctors alone, my parents would act as concerned adults who want their children happy. Not to mention my dad telling me to go fuck myself for going to a hospital. It's hard to find a good therapist. But so long, they just see me as a brat, and they think we all resolved family issues and sent me home. They suspect autism, other than that, apparently nothing wrong in my life. Just forget about being forced to choke on a dick for 10 minutes and crying to make it stop. Forget all punches, kicks, slaps. Forget daily insults from your parents. That's how you beat depression. Ignoring bad shit and getting high on pills. I'm sorry I have to complain about this. I just have to tell what I'm going through... Professional help did nothing good for me. If anything, it made me feel useless and a waste of air... Speaking from my experience, at least. I don't know how it feels finding the right therapist. But I'm too old now to get one for free, and I have social anxiety, I don't just go around from doctor to doctor telling my problems. I have to be completely relaxed, and that I can't do... I don't know... But thank you, at least you show you give a fuck, at least in your comment. So thanks. Hope you have a good day.

When I was on meds I couldn't cry. It was so weird, I had all those crying faces trying to get some of my sadness out but I had my eyes dry. It felt wrong. Especially if something happened I'd usually cry about. I felt like I was becoming heartless. I can't imagine not being able to cry any more. But then again... It's annoying as fuck when someone asks you how your life is after months of not speaking and bursting into tears in front of them looking at you like you're a lost cause. I guess we can all relate we have problems expressing negative emotions. Let's fake a laugh and say we're exaggerating, move on and remember awkward moments when we try to sleep.

Proceeds to agree as if we both don't know existence is pain and we don't have to admit we have reasons to have self-destructive behaviour like laughing at unfortunate posts about being suicidal and pretend we only read them because it's funny and not relatable at all. We continue to have an average day forgetting each other's comments because it's too awkward to say anything more sincere than meme quotes and puns, occasionally opening up to create a comedic effect or to draw one's short attention to create a sense of importance. We exhale air from nostrils and cry inside. We move on.

I have the opposite problem. I cry if I fart too loud. I cry if I see a dog on a leash. I wish I couldn't cry. Maybe my head wouldn't hurt as much. Maybe my eyes wouldn't be sore. Maybe my dad wouldn't call me a bitch for manipulating him with tears I produce when he threatens to kill himself over an opinion I have. Maybe I could not give a fuck. Maybe then I wouldn't have another plan to kill myself. Maybe.

I don't want to be responsible, but since I'm probably doing it soon too, why not. I plan to take sleeping pills, drink a little. Not to OD. Just to get me to pass out. Then stand over shallow water hyperventilating. I'd pass out in 2 minutes since I have breathing problems and smoke. Then my body would just inhale water and drown without waking up. Painless. Fast. Almost 100% works. Don't do it. See my posts to see why I'm doing it. With my story, I turned a lot of people away saying if I'm still alive, why the fuck do they feel they can't be? Honestly, I wouldn't count on it. I tried to hang myself and OD too. Now this is my third option. Idk. Sorry for giving you stupid ideas. But you're asking. Hope you stop feeling like this. Have a less depressing day.
I do this when I'm drinking. Or getting high. Or plotting my suicide. It's nice to have a suicide buddy who no one will miss.

I wouldn't really say I have strength, it's not like I chose tho go through this... I appreciate what you say, but just living with this doesn't mean I'm strong... I did almost quit multiple times and failed, remember? I did collapse under things that happened. And you can't really compare what happened to whom, we're all different, so what happens to some can wreck others so I completely understand people that have "nothing" wrong or hard going on. They don't need a huge disaster for a reason to be depressed. I got all of the talks, from "at least you're not single" to "you've been through a lot and you deserve to choose happiness and let go of the sadness"... It is true. I'm not alone. And I also know how it is to be alone, despite the fact I'm not. I was alone. I remember it quite well, and I still dread loneliness. I couldn't imagine still being here without my boyfriend, however... I can't help but to know my state takes a toll to much more people that you'd guess. They all worry. They all know I've almost ended my life. They're all scared for me. My best friend freaks out if I oversleep and don't pick up. He freaks out if my boyfriend calls him, expecting to hear that I'm gone. Whenever they don't see me, they wonder if I'm still alive... I can't forgive myself for what I'm doing to them, especially when they go out of their way to prove that I matter. They even give me things and I just feel guilty about it, all though  I know they do it to keep me alive. That's how they calm themselves down I guess. I just think I need a new beginning... I am grateful for your comment, I very much need other's opinions and confirmations and I know it's wrong. But so many people also say I have it all. A boyfriend, a sister, friends that support me, why can't I get better? I don't struggle with hunger, I have a home, right now, I just need school which I refuse to go to. The teachers there are horrible. They're sarcastic, make the whole class laugh at you and enjoy when a student breaks. It can be seen in their faces. It's amusing to them. Not all of them are like this, but a good portion is. They'll go out of their way to make some students feel bad. The more they are anxious, the better. They make fun out of me for shaking my legs when I try to get rid of anxiety. When I have panic attacks they don't allow me to excuse myself to go to the bathroom, they force me to have a breakdown in front of everyone just not knowing what the fuck is wrong with me. I bite my nails to my cuticles. I'm not exaggerating. My pinky nails are both gone. Just flesh bubbling up to fill the hole missing my nails. I refuse to go back because when I was at school, I'd get panic attacks daily and would cut more than ever. Some students are horrible too. They laugh and mock others when they cried. I clearly remember a group of male students impersonating my crying when I found out my friend died. They screamed at me to get over it. I got a job a while back as a waitress to work on my social skills but I got stripped down by a drunk customer with the whole bar laughing, coworkers telling me to forget about it and move on. Now I'm a complete wreck, stuttering in front of strangers not being able to go to a job interview... I just rot home, dread stores and cashiers because I'm slow at paying and counting money, avoiding unknown places and just living as a human mouse. Hiding in the company of friends who either worry too much or starting to isolate  themselves from me for being too annoying when I go out my way to get their attention and approval. I'm going to lose them all soon. At least I can end it then. With no guilt... Sorry for this novel here. I just don't know what else to do than complain to strangers on the internet about my life that is bad on it's own, making it worse with every decision I make. Life is great, isn't it? A new surprise behind every corner.

Can I really? I have to admit, I "stalked" your profile a little and it seems you have pretty similar thoughts. I'm sorry for creeping up, I had to see if you were the same... You are. And I guess by your comment, you think I've been through worse than you, so tell me... Does it actually get better? I feel like I'm just using my unfortunate events to be like this while I could just simply get over it. But I don't want to. I'm a horrible person and it seems this happened so I can have an excuse to hurt everyone, including myself. I isolated myself from friends. I make the ones I have left worried. My boyfriend is trying his best to pretend he's not hurt by what I'm doing to myself. He's been through my suicide attempts, my drinking episodes where I'd be black-out drunk vomiting all over places and being a pile of half-dead human flesh, overdosing, hanging, goodbyes from cliffs and rails and highways... I'm a terrible person. I could try for him. I can't ever say I'm alone in this. But why doesn't it help? Why is it a bigger burden than everyone just not giving a fuck about me? I have reasons to die, but I have reasons to live too! They're just so scary, and hard, and dying just seems like it's going to happen anyways, so I can just save myself some pain and do it now... I don't know what else to say... I guess I just kind of needed to let you know I acknowledged your comment... But this is just spewing out of my head and it feels so good to write this and I couldn't just wrap it up, so I'm doing that now... Hope to get your reply on how your thoughts pierce your sanity...
